domains.title: Project Leadership
domains.summary: Reserved for coordination, project framing, meeting cadence, and cross-page decision ownership.

domains.title: Wet Lab
domains.summary: Reserved for strain construction, pathway assembly, protocols, controls, and experimental execution.

domains.title: Dry Lab / Model
domains.summary: Reserved for model assumptions, simulation work, data analysis, sequence design, and computational support.

domains.title: Wiki / Visual Design
domains.summary: Reserved for page architecture, graphics, copy editing, motion, accessibility, and final wiki assembly.

domains.title: Human Practices
domains.summary: Reserved for stakeholder interviews, public engagement, implementation research, and feedback translation.

domains.title: Safety / Documentation
domains.summary: Reserved for safety forms, risk review, record keeping, and compliance documentation.

domains.title: Advisors & Instructors
domains.summary: Reserved for instructor, PI, advisor, and host-lab support that should be clearly distinguished from student work.

domains.title: External Resources & Tools
domains.summary: Reserved for software, databases, design tools, AI assistance, commercial support, and other external resources.
